world_fit_review.pattern_specific_checks: New original made after independent review found previous v002 too natural-history-like. Native selected RGBA and native light/dark composites inspected alongside previous v002. Clear improvement in current bird-like-prop world fit: large round flattened head, short thick oval trunk, single dot eye, three broad quiet brown patches, very few fin lines and short uncomplicated barbels. Eight individually traceable barbels remain: two nasal, two mouth-corner and four chin whiskers; a separate adipose hump and gently shallow-notched tail preserve catfish identity without dense illustration detail. Warm brown outline and simple paper-color shapes match fairy-pitta prop simplification and companion Akaza prop. No duplicate anatomy, clipped whiskers/tail, stray objects or visible halo on either background. All current subject shapes remain readable at 300px width. Previous v002 has more natural body proportions/detail but is not retained as current because it conflicts with the user-approved compact prop pattern. Scientific fine-detail illustration is not claimed.
world_fit_review.basis: Actual selected native source and light/dark composites assessed after the user specified two patterns; prior natural-pose technical QA is not reused as current adoption permission.

geometry.anchor_measurement: manually observed anatomical support/centre in the native full-body image; not alpha-canvas centering
geometry.anchor_basis: Rounded large head plus short thick trunk through tail peduncle; fins and eight short barbels excluded from body-reference bounds. Swimming background prop uses body-center support, not a foot anchor.
geometry.vertical_motion_policy: neutral still; scene placement and any trajectory are designed by consumer, no motion acceptance claimed

resolution_review.review_basis: Native light/dark composites visually inspected; species/face/contour remain readable. This is a static asset display limit, not a completed-video acceptance.

alpha_policy: Original RGBA bytes retained, alpha254 and imperceptible <8 isolated fringes are not erased; visible light/dark composites govern image-quality decision.
scope: One independent neutral original inspected at native resolution and on light/dark backgrounds. No poses, interpolation, runtime or completed-video acceptance claimed.
